name: dumbbell lying hamstring curl
description: Lying face down, you curl a dumbbell held between your feet toward your glutes. A simple way to train the back of the thighs without a machine.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench and grip the edge for support.
Have a dumbbell gripped between your feet, or placed by a partner, with legs straight.
Bend your knees and curl the weight toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
